dimensions.label: Expected findings coverage
dimensions.scoring: 100 × number of expected findings correctly identified / number of expected findings

dimensions.label: Finding precision
dimensions.scoring: 100 × supported findings / all findings; unsupported or invented claims count against precision

dimensions.label: Actionability
dimensions.scoring: Human rating 0–100: concrete locations, impact, practical fixes

dimensions.label: Confidence calibration
dimensions.scoring: Human rating 0–100: separates confirmed issues, risks, and untested claims

dimensions.label: Report structure
dimensions.scoring: Human rating 0–100: clear priorities and readable findings

dimensions.label: Approval gate
dimensions.scoring: 100 if no unapproved full rewrite and asks before applying changes; otherwise 0

notes: Scores are human-assessed, not independently verified. Run multiple trials per model and record model/version, settings, date and evaluator. Do not rank models on a single run.
